description: Younes, Amin and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The native deposit explicitly provides raw data and analysis code used to assess offshore wind resources against local electricity load in Humboldt County, California. The data and their bundled analysis utilities form one published research package. Its short description does not specify the complete variable schema, period, measurement resolution or exact software model. Those details remain unknown. The resource has a concrete electricity supply-demand assessment role, but it is not described as a validated operating offshore installation or as a separately named general-purpose simulator. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
